'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**[[2024 Reasi attack]]
*** Nine people are killed and 41 others are injured near [[Reasi]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]], when a bus carrying [[Hinduism in India|Hindu]] [[pilgrim]]s falls into a [[ravine]] after being shot at. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/9/at-least-nine-killed-after-attack-on-bus-in-indian-administered-kashmir (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[2024 Lakki Marwat bombing]]
***An [[Improvised explosive device|IED]] kills seven [[Pakistan Army]] personnel in [[Lakki Marwat District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistans-army-says-bomb-blast-kills-seven-soldiers-2024-06-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Two people are killed in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s near [[Aitaroun]], [[Lebanon]], according to the [[National News Agency (Lebanon)|National News Agency]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/8/two-killed-in-southern-lebanon-as-hezbollah-israel-fighting-soars (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*President [[Bernardo Arévalo]] announced that the remains of [[Guatemala]]n writer and 1967 [[Nobel Prize]] winner for Literature, [[Miguel Ángel Asturias]], would be repatriated to Guatemala. Asturias is buried in the [[Père Lachaise Cemetery]] in [[Paris]], [[France]]. [https://www.dw.com/es/guatemala-repatriar%C3%A1-los-restos-de-miguel-%C3%A1ngel-asturias/a-69318089 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least twenty-two people are killed and 48 injured after a truck collided with a bus in [[Sofala]], [[Mozambique]]. [https://english.news.cn/20240610/e87f42ef09fe48afbdfe99b7adbffb5b/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[South Korea]] announces that it will resume [[Propaganda in South Korea|loudspeaker broadcasts]] over the [[Korean Demilitarized Zone]] for the first time since 2018 in response to [[North Korea]] sending hundreds of balloons carrying [[garbage]] across the border. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1rr92dwqnyo (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Cannabis in Slovenia]]
**[[Slovenians|Slovenian]] voters approve the use of [[cannabis (drug)|cannabis]] for [[Medical cannabis|medicinal]] and [[Recreational drug use|recreational use]] in adults. [https://english.sta.si/3310327/voters-support-medical-personal-use-of-cannabis (STA)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israeli war cabinet]]
***[[Israeli war cabinet|War Cabinet]] Minister [[Benny Gantz]] [[resign]]s after [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] failed to present a post-war plan for [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] by Gantz's previously announced June 8 deadline. Minister [[Gadi Eisenkot]] also resigns. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clkkdymdwlvo (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Belgian federal election]]
**[[Belgians]] vote for the 150 members of the [[Chamber of Representatives (Belgium)|Chamber of Representatives]] as well as for [[2024 Belgian regional elections|regional representatives]] and [[2024 European Parliament election|members of the European Parliament]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/jun/08/belgium-general-election-european-elections-vlaams-belang (''The Guardian'')]
*[[June 2024 Bulgarian parliamentary election]]
**[[Bulgarians]] vote for the sixth time in three years to elect the 240 members of the [[National Assembly (Bulgaria)|parliament]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/bulgaria-to-elect-sixth-parliament-in-three-years/a-69294114 (DW)]
*[[2024 European Parliament election]]
**The last day of the [[European Parliament]] elections takes place, with voting occurring in 20 countries. [https://apnews.com/article/eu-election-right-migration-climate-polls-vote-0fbfcb7bd987008e802d70f759fa870b (AP)]
*[[2024 French legislative election]]
**Following major losses for [[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]]'s [[Renaissance (French political party)|Renaissance]] party in the [[2024 European Parliament election|European Parliament elections]], Macron [[2024 dissolution of the National Assembly|dissolves]] the [[National Assembly (France)|National Assembly]] and calls snap elections for June 30 and July 7. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/le-pens-party-trounces-macrons-eu-vote-exit-polls-2024-06-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Indian general election]]
**[[Narendra Modi]] is sworn in for his third term as [[Prime Minister of India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/9/indias-narendra-modi-sworn-in-as-countrys-prime-minister-for-a-third-term (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 Mexican general election]]
**[[Mexico]]'s ruling party [[Morena (political party)|Morena]] and its coalition allies win a [[supermajority]] in the [[Chamber of Deputies (Mexico)|Chamber of Deputies]] but not in the [[Senate of the Republic (Mexico)|Senate]], falling short of the two-thirds majority needed to change the [[Constitution of Mexico|Constitution]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-ruling-party-misses-senate-super-majority-wins-lower-house-morena-says-2024-06-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 San Marino general election]]
**[[Sammarinese]] elect the members of the [[Grand and General Council]]. [https://www.libertas.sm/oggi-elezioni-a-san-marino-il-messaggio-dei-capitani-reggenti-la-faticosa-conquista-del-diritto-di-voto-non-puo-essere-messa-a-repentaglio-per-sfiducia/ (Libertas)]
*[[2024 South Ossetian parliamentary election]]
**[[Parliament of South Ossetia|Parliamentary]] elections are held in the [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]n breakaway region of [[South Ossetia]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/world/georgia-condemns-election-held-in-breakaway-region-of-south-ossetia/3244953 (Anadolu Ajansi)]
*[[2024 Swiss referendums]]
**Voters in [[Switzerland]] reject limits on healthcare spending and an initiative against compulsory vaccination, while approving the initiative of a new law on electricity. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/swiss-politics/swiss-vote-on-healthcare-spending-electricity-and-vaccinations/79834485 (Swissinfo)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 French Open]]
**In [[tennis]], [[Carlos Alcaraz]] wins the [[2024 French Open – Men's singles|Men's singles title]] at the [[French Open]] after defeating [[Alexander Zverev]] in the final, earning his third [[Grand Slam (tennis)#Tournaments|Grand Slam]] title. [https://apnews.com/article/french-open-2024-men-final-alcaraz-zverev-84b987ef5a0bf17c2d188a5a9bbd2d28 (AP)]
